primary.title: Are you eligible for interest on your ITR refund? Experts explain income tax rules, calculations and key conditions
primary.summary: Waiting for your ITR refund? A delayed refund does not automatically mean you will receive interest. Here’s when interest may be payable under Section 244A, how it is calculated, and the key conditions taxpayers need to know.

related.title: ITR filed in July, but refund still not received? Expert explains key reasons for the delay and what taxpayers can do
related.summary: Filed your ITR in July or August but still waiting for your refund? Delays can happen for several reasons, from mismatches in tax details to processing issues. Here’s what taxpayers should check on the e-filing portal and when they may need to take further action.
